title: Designing the game
detail: Make a crazy racing game where humanoids fight while racing, with loops, twists and hover sections, on Unity and Roblox

title: Track: wavy, 960 m
detail: 2 loops, 2 twists, 22 m drop, hover sections

title: 6 karts, riders with a noodle
detail: Zibbo, Vemli, Pogrin, Dazzu, Wiblet, Tufflo

summary: Noodle Rush: Humanoid riders swing floppy noodles through a wild daytime race packed with loops, twists and hover sections. Stay close, shove rivals sideways and chase the lead through the final plunge.
